submitted.rationale: XRD showed one peak (Q≈2.77 Å⁻¹) that was the same at all five compositions, so it gave no phase guidance. I spread the three merit measurements across the composition range. Photocurrent fell steadily as the Ca fraction rose: 3.81 µA at Ca 0.275, 1.80 µA at Ca 0.404 and 1.32 µA at Ca 0.508. The Mn-richest end, index 28, is the best measured composition.

rejected.reason: 1.32 uA, lowest; photocurrent falls as Ca increases
